results.title: Singer Chris Brown pleads guilty over bottle attack at a London nightclub
results.description: LONDON — Grammy-winning singer Chris Brown pleaded guilty Friday to brawling at a London nightclub in 2023 when he hit a music producer on the head with a bottle.
